temel.soru: Sipariş kalemi başına ortalama kargo ücreti ne kadar?
temel.sql:
SELECT AVG(freight_value) AS ortalama_kargo_ücreti
FROM order_items;

temel.soru: Ağırlığı 10 kg'dan fazla olan kaç ürün var?
Ödeme yöntemlerine göre kaç ödeme yapılmış?
temel.sql:
SELECT payment_type, COUNT(*) AS ödeme_sayısı
FROM order_payments
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

temel.soru: Kredi kartı ödemelerinde taksit sayısına göre ortalama ödeme tutarı nedir?
temel.sql:
SELECT payment_installments, AVG(payment_value) AS ortalama_tutar
FROM order_payments
WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;

temel.soru: Satıcıların en çok bulunduğu 5 şehir hangileri?
temel.sql:
SELECT s.seller_city, s.seller_state, COUNT(*) AS satici
FROM sellers s
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 3 DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT seller_state, COUNT(*) AS satici_sayisi
FROM sellers
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
ORDER BY 2 DESC;

temel.soru: En az 100 değerlendirmesi olan kategoriler arasında ortalama puanı en düşükolan 5 kategori hangileri?
temel.sql:
SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS kategori,
       AVG(orw.review_score) AS ortalama_puan
FROM order_reviews orw
JOIN orders o ON orw.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON p.product_category_name = t.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT orw.review_id) >= 100
ORDER BY 2 ASC
LIMIT 5;

temel.soru: Geç teslim edilen siparişlerin ortalama puanı,zamanında teslim edilenlerinkinden ne kadar farklı?
temel.sql:
SELECT 
    AVG(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN review_score ELSE 0 END) AS ortalama_gec_teslim_puani,
    AVG(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date <= order_estimated_delivery_date THEN review_score ELSE 0 END) AS ortalama_zamaninda_teslim_puani,
    (AVG(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date THEN review_score ELSE 0 END) - 
     AVG(CASE WHEN order_delivered_customer_date <= order_estimated_delivery_date THEN review_score ELSE 0 END)) AS fark
FROM orders
JOIN order_reviews ON orders.order_id = order_reviews.order_id
WHERE orders.order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL;

temel.soru: Kasım 2017'de en çok siparişin geldiği gün hangisi?
temel.sql:
SELECT EXTRACT(DOW FROM order_purchase_timestamp) AS gun, COUNT(*) AS siparis
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1;

temel.soru: En az 10 siparişi olan satıcılar arasında, siparişleri kargoya vermesi ortalamada en uzun süren 5 satıcı hangileri?
temel.sql:
SELECT o.seller_id, AVG(o.order_delivered_carrier_date - o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS ortalama_kargo_suresi
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
AND o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY o.seller_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 10
ORDER BY ortalama_kargo_suresi DESC
LIMIT 5;

temel.soru: Birden fazla siparişi olan kaç müşteri var?
temel.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS musteri_sayisi
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 2;

temel.soru: Geçen yıl kaç müşteri ilk siparişini verdi?
temel.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS musteri_sayisi
FROM customers
WHERE customer_unique_id IN (
    SELECT customer_unique_id
    FROM customers
    GROUP BY customer_unique_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
)
AND customer_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM orders
    WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
);

duzeltme.soru: En az 100 değerlendirmesi olan kategoriler arasında ortalama puanı en düşükolan 5 kategori hangileri?
duzeltme.sql:
WITH kategori_puan AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS kategori,
         AVG(r.review_score) AS ortalama_puan,
         COUNT(*) AS degerlendirme_sayisi
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p USING (product_id)
  LEFT JOIN product_category_name_translation t USING (product_category_name)
  JOIN order_reviews r USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT kategori, ortalama_puan, degerlendirme_sayisi
FROM kategori_puan
WHERE degerlendirme_sayisi >= 100
ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 5;

duzeltme.soru: Geç teslim edilen siparişlerin ortalama puanı,zamanında teslim edilenlerinkinden ne kadar farklı?
duzeltme.sql:
WITH s AS (
   SELECT r.review_score,
          o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date AS gec
   FROM orders o
   JOIN order_reviews r USING (order_id)
   WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
 )
 SELECT AVG(review_score) FILTER (WHERE gec) AS gec_puan,
        AVG(review_score) FILTER (WHERE NOT gec) AS zamaninda_puan,
        AVG(review_score) FILTER (WHERE NOT gec) - AVG(review_score) FILTER (WHERE gec) AS fark
 FROM s;

duzeltme.soru: Kasım 2017'de en çok siparişin geldiği gün hangisi?
duzeltme.sql:
SELECT order_purchase_timestamp::date AS gun, COUNT(*) AS siparis
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-11-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-12-01'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1;

duzeltme.soru: En az 10 siparişi olan satıcılar arasında, siparişleri kargoya vermesi ortalamada en uzun süren 5 satıcı hangileri?
duzeltme.sql:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT oi.seller_id, o.order_id, o.order_purchase_timestamp, o.order_delivered_carrier_date
  FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o USING (order_id)
  WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_carrier_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT seller_id,
       AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM order_delivered_carrier_date - order_purchase_timestamp) / 86400) AS ortalama_gun
FROM s
GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10
ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS musteri
FROM (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id
  FROM customers c
  JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 1
) x;

duzeltme.soru: Geçen yıl kaç müşteri ilk siparişini verdi?
duzeltme.sql:
WITH ilk AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS ilk_siparis
  FROM customers c JOIN orders o USING (customer_id)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS yeni_musteri 
FROM ilk
WHERE ilk_siparis >= '2017-01-01' 
  AND ilk_siparis < '2018-01-01';
